title: HTML Capsule Manifest
description: Schema v0.1 for capsule.manifest.yaml — the canonical metadata envelope for every HTML Capsule. Defined in Spec §10. Template-specific extension fields are allowed via additionalProperties: true at the top level.

html_capsule.description: Root envelope for all capsule manifest fields.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Must be exactly '0.1' for this schema release. Renderers MUST reject unknown versions.

capsule_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this capsule. Recommended format: snake_case descriptive slug.

capsule_type.description: Declares which template family renders this capsule.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the capsule was first created. YAML parsers (PyYAML) auto-deserialize timestamp strings to native datetime objects; the schema accepts any value to remain YAML-loader-agnostic. Renderers should call str() when formatting.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update. Same YAML-loader note as created_at — type constraint omitted intentionally.

owner.description: Name or identifier of the person or agent that owns this capsule.

interactivity_level.description: Declares the interaction tier of the rendered capsule. Can be specified as an L-prefix string (from Spec §12) or as a shorthand enum.

oneOf.description: L-prefix interactivity tier from Spec §12: L0_static, L1_local, L2_exportable, L3_authenticated, L4_reviewed, L5_collaborative.

safe_html_mode.description: Safe HTML enforcement level. 'strict' applies the full Spec §18 CSP with no external resources. 'relaxed' loosens connect-src for trusted local/private endpoints. Boolean true maps to strict.

oneOf.description: Legacy boolean form: true = strict, false = relaxed.

source_of_truth.description: References to the canonical source artifacts backing this capsule. At least one source must be provided.

markdown.description: Relative path to the canonical Markdown source file.

structured_data.description: Relative path to a JSON or YAML data file.

manifest.description: Relative path to the manifest file itself (self-reference allowed).

design_spec.description: Relative path to a design specification document.

human_brief.description: Relative path to a human-authored brief.

run_log.description: Relative path to an agent run log.

git_ref.description: Git commit SHA or ref that backs this capsule.

rendered_view.description: Metadata about the rendered HTML output.

html.description: Relative path to the rendered HTML file.

interactivity_level.description: Interactivity level of the rendered view (see Spec §12).

safe_html_mode.description: Safe HTML mode applied during rendering.

agentic_context.description: References to the agentic work context that produced this capsule.

evidence.description: Validation and evidence signals for this capsule.

writebacks.description: Proposed writeback targets and their statuses. At least one target must be declared. Keys are target system names; values are writeback descriptors.

writeback_entry.description: A single writeback target descriptor. May be a status string or an object with target and status.

target.description: Destination path, node ID, or endpoint within the target system.
